note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative: the circumstance, the communication and the sections of the termination clause are generic placeholders, never real contract text or notices. "Provided for" and "not described" are supplied cases of equal weight (● and ◆ of the same area, colour and stroke); the joined outline only shows the link that is supplied, drawn without arrows. No termination doctrine is stated: no ground or right to terminate, no notice period or time limit, no effect, no validity or sufficiency judgement, and no jurisdiction; the case "not described" is neutral (the outline closes around the empty band, no conclusion). Brief customizable fields not exposed (coordinator decision BRIEF CUSTOMIZABLE FIELDS, SESSION_HANDOFF 2026-10-05): schedules, definitions, priorities, relationships and relationLabels (the only relation drawn is the supplied link, as a plain relation), elements (the element labels are the contract, clause, circumstance and communication fields).
